text:
The owner agent `mastermind-in-flight-dashboard` now has two requested fixes to `in-flight-dashboard/requirements.md`. I didn't edit the file myself, since that agent is still working on it. The text check came back clean, and I logged a "sent" line in `flags.jsonl`.

- **Title:** it ran about 25 words and carried a role note. I asked for a short title, `In flight: the 3–5 tasks being worked on now, and what's next`, with the role note moved to the Budget line.
- **Layout told, not shown:** the dashboard's layout was described in five bullets. I asked for a small sketch of it, a checklist of the owner's asks (`- [ ]` until proven), and the two `.js` paths turned into links.

I didn't shoot any page, because this is a proposal with no page yet.

I wrote the review to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/in-flight-dashboard/review.md` with `verdict: fix`, which is a verdict from reading the diff, not from running anything. I did not run the unit test, open the page, or look at any shot.

The main gaps:
- **No proof:** the task folder has no 360 and 1920 shots, and none of the five asks in `requirements.md` is ticked.
- **Dashboard query unconfirmed:** `AIDashboard.js:33-39` filters on `state` and `last_activity` and reads `url` from each row. I couldn't confirm the `inflight` source returns those fields. If it doesn't, the block renders nothing and looks like "nothing in flight".
- **Comment misplaced:** in `AISessionDetail.js:47-50` the "Figma band E: stats first, sticky" comment now sits on the new `$inflight` line instead of `SessionStats`.
- **"Done today" is not today:** it counts every completed task, which in this session would be hundreds.
- **Next missing across sessions:** the dashboard view hides the "Next" section, though the brief asked for the same component. The doc doesn't say so.
- **Unindexed:** the framework readme index, `ai/readme.md` and `ext/Query/readme.md` don't mention the new view.

I also left notes on the readers never being closed, the task row not being reused from `core/Task/TaskView.js`, and the hard-coded CSS widths.

I wrote the review to `in-flight-dashboard/review.md` with verdict: fix. It has five fixes and five notes. I could not run the unit test: `InFlight.test.mjs` exists only in the worktree, not in the main tree, so the test's pass is unverified.

The five fixes:
- **No ticks or proof:** none of the five asks in `requirements.md` is ticked, and nothing records the test passing.
- **No `/framework/ai/` shot:** the folder only has session-page shots at 360 and 1920, and the cross-session block is a separate code path.
- **Stale module readme:** `ai/AIDashboard/readme.md` doesn't list the new in-flight section or its source.
- **Broken sentence in `ai/readme.md`:** line 61 has a dangling parenthetical left over from the edit.
- **Comment contradicts query:** the comment says "active in the last hour", but the query has no one-hour cutoff, so idle active sessions can crowd out real work.

The notes cover the duplicate `inflight` query (AINow already holds the same one), the all-time done count where the ask said "today", and the missing Next and Done blocks at `/framework/ai/`. They also flag the 36 running tasks on this session, which push the ProcessRunner fix and the rename out of view. The last two are the "0%" bar on waiting rows plus the nowrap truncation at 360, and a Next section not visible in either shot.

I've written the review to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/in-flight-dashboard/review.md` with verdict: fix. It has six `[fix]` findings and four `[note]` findings. I read the requirements, the diff and both shots; I ran nothing, including the unit test.

- **Done count:** "Done today" is built as an all-time "N done" that isn't collapsed. The doc admits this, but the requirement was never changed.
- **Stale shot:** the 1920 shot still draws progress bars on the "Waiting on you" rows, which the code no longer does. The shot predates the fix.
- **Incomplete walkthrough:** neither shot shows the ProcessRunner fix or the `session.sessions` rename waiting. The 360 shot ends at the "Waiting on you" heading.
- **No proof across sessions:** the `/framework/ai/` block returns nothing if the `inflight` query fails, and nothing confirms the query returns `url` per row.
- **Sticky stats:** the new block sits under the sticky stats band on a session page, and I found no check that it behaves on a phone.
- **Picking "major" tasks:** with 36 running tasks, the five shown are chosen only by recency, so a 0% task appears as a major one.

The notes cover the departure from the mockup on `/framework/ai/`, the duplicate `inflight` query, indexing (fine) and the missing test-run record.

I wrote the review to `in-flight-dashboard/review.md` with `verdict: fix`. It has five `[fix]` findings, one more `[fix]` on diff noise, and three `[note]`s. I could not re-run `InFlight.test.mjs` because it is not in the main tree yet. The task log reports 9 checks passing in the worktree.

The `[fix]` findings, in short:
- **Shots stop too early:** both shots cut off at the "Waiting on you" heading, so there is no proof of the `session.sessions` rename or the ProcessRunner fix.
- **"Done today":** it counts every completed task ever, not just today's, and is not collapsed. The requirement is ticked anyway.
- **Not first:** the block sits below the title and the stats card, not at the top of the session page.
- **`/framework/ai/` unproven:** the dashboard path was never shot. It reads the session list once through a stubbed second query, so it does not refresh when sessions change, and it draws nothing on any error.
- **In flight is a flood:** the shot shows "+ 31 more running" and several rows at 0%. Tasks that are only `running` by state push out the 3–5 major ones the owner asked for.
- **Diff noise:** the diff carries `files.jsonl` changes from other tasks' folders and a stray `readme.md.tmp…` entry.

The notes cover the missing `paused`/Prompt test cases, the new row instead of `TaskView.js` (the doc gives a reason), and indexing, which is in good shape.

I wrote the review with `verdict: fix`. It is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/in-flight-dashboard/review.md`.

There are four `[fix]` items:
- **Shots stop too early:** both shots cut off at the "Waiting on you" heading, so waiting, Next and Done are never shown. They also don't show the plugin build, the single voice assistant or the ProcessRunner fix together.
- **`/framework/ai/` block never checked:** it has no shot and no recorded check. The requirements file itself marks that ask as only partly done.
- **"Done today" not met:** the view shows an all-time "N done" count, not collapsed. The doc explains why, but the owner's wording isn't met.
- **No summary in the task folder:** it holds `task.jsonl` review answers and a computed `past-work.md`. A fresh agent has nothing saying what was built and what is left.

There are also four `[note]` items:
- **Empty box:** a leftover empty box on the dashboard when the query fails.
- **Two readers:** two live readers of the same `session.jsonl` on a session page.
- **Cramped titles:** crowded titles at 360 width.
- **Stray index entry:** a stray `readme.md.tmp.*` entry in `core/Session/files.jsonl`.

I made no code edits and did not run the unit test or load the page, so I judged from the diff and the two shots.

I rewrote the in-flight-dashboard task's owner-facing text and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. I did not run `layout-check.mjs` or look at the live `/framework/ai/` page. The only screenshot I looked at is the agent's own 1920 shot. No agent owns the task now, so I applied the fix myself.

- **Outcome:** `task.jsonl` had no outcome line, so I added one. It names what shipped and what didn't.
- **Asks list:** `requirements.md` listed only five asks, and none of them had its own proof. It now has nine, each ticked with a shot or left open:
  - **Not met or unproven:**
    - the "Next" row is in neither shot;
    - "Done today" shows an all-time count, not a count for today;
    - the `/framework/ai/` block was never shot;
    - live updating from `session.jsonl` has no recorded proof.
  - **Ticked with a shot:** the in-flight rows with progress bars, the waiting rows, the top-of-page placement, and the 360 shot.
- **Contradiction on the page (UI):** the stats card above the new block says "0 running" and "no task folders", while the block below shows five tasks in flight and "+ 31 more running". I did not touch the code. I noted it in the flag line; I did not message anyone, so it still needs an owner.
- **`text-check.mjs`:** it flagged `review.md` for one 65-word paragraph and for having no picture. That file is for reviewers, not the owner, so I left it.
